title: Make Review 2026: Visual Automation Without the Code
excerpt: Make (formerly Integromat) lets you connect thousands of apps with a drag-and-drop canvas. Here is who it suits, what it costs and where it can surprise you.
content:
This review summarizes official product information together with user feedback and expert reviews from trusted sources (listed at the end). Prices change often, so always confirm the current offer on the official site.

## Overview

Make is a no-code automation platform. You build "scenarios" on a visual canvas, linking apps such as Google Sheets, Slack, Shopify or OpenAI, and Make runs the steps for you on a schedule or trigger.

## Key features

- Drag-and-drop scenario editor with routers, filters and error handling
- Thousands of app integrations plus HTTP/webhook modules for anything else
- AI agents and AI modules for content and data tasks
- Team plans with shared workspaces

## Pricing

There is a free plan with 1,000 credits per month. Paid plans (Core, Pro, Teams) start at roughly $9/month when billed yearly. Each module action uses a credit, so a long scenario that runs often can consume a monthly allowance fast. Estimate your usage before upgrading.

## What users say

On GetApp most reviewers say Make offers **strong value for money** with a generous free plan, while some find the credit-based pricing confusing. Independent reviewers rate it around 4.2/5 and praise the flexibility of the visual builder.

## Who it's for

Small businesses, marketers and freelancers who want more power than simple "if this then that" tools without hiring a developer.

## Verdict

Make is one of the best-value automation tools available. Start on the free plan, learn how credits are counted, then scale up.

## Sources

- [Make official site](https://www.make.com)
- [GetApp – Make reviews](https://www.getapp.com/it-management-software/a/integromat/)
- [Zapier – Make pricing breakdown](https://zapier.com/blog/make-com-pricing/)
price: Free plan; paid plans from about $9/month (billed yearly)
pros: Visual scenario builder that shows every step
Strong value compared with similar tools
cons: Credit-based billing can be hard to predict
author: onapqua. Editorial

title: Cherry Servers Review: Bare Metal Servers With Flexible Billing
excerpt: Cherry Servers offers dedicated and bare metal cloud servers with hourly or fixed-term billing and well-rated 24/7 support.
content:
This review summarizes official product information together with user feedback and expert reviews from trusted sources (listed at the end). Prices change often, so always confirm the current offer on the official site.

## Overview

Cherry Servers is a Lithuania-based infrastructure provider focused on dedicated (bare metal) servers, bare metal cloud and virtual servers. It is popular with developers, Web3 projects and companies that need predictable performance.

## Key features

- Dedicated servers with hourly billing or fixed terms (savings up to around 50% on longer terms)
- Locations across Europe, the US, Singapore and Japan
- Included bandwidth packages; only egress traffic counts toward usage
- API, Terraform support and free 24/7 human support

## Pricing

You can pay by the hour to test a server, then switch to monthly or annual billing to save. Final cost depends on hardware, location and traffic. Reviewers note pricing sits on the higher end, which is the trade-off for hardware quality and support.

## What users say

Cherry Servers holds an "Excellent" rating of around 4.4–4.6 on Trustpilot. Users repeatedly praise **fast, knowledgeable support**. A minority report billing disputes or latency on particular network routes.

## Verdict

A strong choice if you need real dedicated hardware with flexible billing and responsive engineers. Budget-focused users may find cheaper options elsewhere.

title: Topaz Labs Review: AI Photo and Video Enhancement for Creators
excerpt: Topaz Labs makes AI tools that upscale, sharpen and denoise photos and videos. Here is what the new Topaz Studio subscription gives you.
content:
This review summarizes official product information together with user feedback and expert reviews from trusted sources (listed at the end). Prices change often, so always confirm the current offer on the official site.

## Overview

Topaz Labs is best known for Gigapixel (image upscaling), Photo AI (sharpen, denoise, face recovery) and Video AI (upscaling and frame interpolation). Photographers, video editors and archivists use it to rescue low-quality or old footage.

## Key features

- AI upscaling of photos and video, up to very high resolutions
- Noise reduction, sharpening and face recovery
- Frame interpolation for smooth slow motion
- Topaz Studio bundle with cloud credits for heavier video jobs

## Pricing

In late 2025 Topaz moved to subscriptions. According to the official pricing page, **Topaz Studio** costs about $399 billed annually (or a higher monthly price), and Studio Pro adds more cloud credits and full commercial use. There is no free plan, but trials are available.

## What users say

Users consistently praise the quality of results. Long-time customers were disappointed by the end of perpetual licenses. Reviewers note occasional artifacts on skin, fabric or hair when settings are pushed too far.

## Verdict

If you regularly enhance photos or video, Topaz remains one of the best tools available. Try the trial on your own files before subscribing.

title: WP Fusion Review: Connect WordPress to Your CRM

content:

## Overview

WP Fusion is a WordPress plugin that links your website to CRM and marketing automation platforms such as ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, FluentCRM or Mailchimp. It uses tags and field syncing to trigger automations based on what users do on your site.

## Key features

- Two-way sync of users and custom fields
- Apply tags on purchases, course completions, form submissions and more
- Restrict content based on CRM tags
- Integrations with WooCommerce, LearnDash, MemberPress and many other plugins

A free **Lite** version is available on WordPress.org. Paid plans are billed yearly with flat pricing and no per-contact limits, and come with a money-back guarantee. Check the official pricing page for the current tiers.

## What users say

Reviewers at WPBeginner and other WordPress specialists praise its **breadth of integrations** and reliability. The main drawbacks are price and the time needed to design a good tagging strategy.

## Verdict

For membership sites, online courses and WooCommerce stores that rely on email automation, WP Fusion is one of the most powerful options available.

title: WPvivid Review: Backup, Migration and Staging for WordPress

content:

## Overview

WPvivid Backup & Migration is used on hundreds of thousands of WordPress sites. It creates backups, moves sites between hosts and builds staging copies so you can test changes safely.

- Manual and scheduled backups to Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Amazon S3 and more
- One-click migration to a new domain or host
- Staging sites for testing updates
- Pro: incremental backups, multisite support, white label and more

## Pricing

The free version covers basic backups and migration. **Pro** plans start at around $49/year, and WPvivid also sells lifetime licenses (for example a 2-domain lifetime plan). Check the pricing page for current offers.

Reviewers such as WPExplorer and Dave Swift highlight how much the free version can do and the value of incremental backups in Pro. The most common complaint is the lack of real-time support.

An excellent, budget-friendly backup and migration tool. Start free, and upgrade to Pro if you manage several sites or need incremental backups.

title: MyPrivateProxy Review: Dedicated Datacenter Proxies
excerpt: MyPrivateProxy sells private, dedicated and shared datacenter proxies in the US and Europe. We look at pricing, locations and limitations.
content:
This review summarizes official product information together with user feedback and expert reviews from trusted sources (listed at the end). Prices change often, so always confirm the current offer on the official site.

## Overview

MyPrivateProxy (MPP) is a long-running provider of datacenter proxies. It offers private proxies (used only by you), dedicated proxies for specific use cases and cheaper shared proxies.

## Key features

- Proxy servers in many US cities and European locations
- HTTP/HTTPS proxies with IP or user/password authentication
- Instant setup and IP replacement options
- Bulk pricing that drops the per-proxy cost

## Pricing

Private proxy plans start at around $2.49 per proxy per month and fall to about $1 per proxy at large volumes. There is no free trial, but reviewers mention a short money-back window.

## What users say

HostAdvice and other reviewers call its pricing **competitive** for static datacenter proxies. Proxyway's review was more critical about how products and pricing are presented. As with any datacenter proxy, some high-security websites detect and block these IPs.

## Who it's for

SEO tools, social media management, general browsing privacy and tasks that do not require residential IPs.

## Verdict

A good-value datacenter proxy provider. If you need to access sites that block datacenter traffic, consider residential proxies instead.

title: Best VPS & Server Hosting in 2026: 6 Providers Compared
excerpt: From budget European VPS to bare metal and privacy-first offshore hosting, here is how six popular providers compare, and which one fits your project.
content:
Choosing a server is mostly about matching your project to the right trade-off: price, performance, location, privacy or payment method. We compared six providers using official specifications and published user and expert reviews.

## Quick picks

- **Best overall for dedicated hardware:** [Cherry Servers](/review/cherry-servers-review)
- **Best budget VPS in Europe:** [Time4VPS](/review/time4vps-review)
- **Best for many server locations:** [MonoVM](/review/monovm-review)
- **Best for paying with crypto:** [BitLaunch](/review/bitlaunch-review)
- **Best for offshore privacy:** [Shinjiru](/review/shinjiru-review)
- **Best for a Thai audience:** [Hostatom](/review/hostatom-review)

## Comparison table

| Provider | Best for | Starting price | Our score | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cherry Servers | Bare metal, flexible billing | Hourly billing | 4.4 / 5 | [View plans](/go/review/review_cherry_servers) |
| Time4VPS | Cheap European VPS | A few euros/month | 4.3 / 5 | [See deals](/go/review/review_time4vps) |
| Hostatom | Websites for Thailand | ~690 THB/year | 3.9 / 5 | [View plans](/go/review/review_hostatom) |
| Shinjiru | Offshore & privacy | ~$3.95/month | 3.8 / 5 | [View plans](/go/review/review_shinjiru) |
| BitLaunch | Crypto-only payments | ~$10–11/month | 3.6 / 5 | [Launch a server](/go/review/review_bitlaunch) |
| MonoVM | 30+ locations | ~$14/month | 3.2 / 5 | [View VPS plans](/go/review/review_monovm) |

## 1. Cherry Servers: best for dedicated hardware

Real bare metal servers with hourly, monthly or yearly billing, free 24/7 engineering support and a strong Trustpilot reputation. It is not the cheapest, but you get predictable performance. [Read our Cherry Servers review](/review/cherry-servers-review).

## 2. Time4VPS: best budget VPS

A Lithuanian host with very low prices and an Excellent Trustpilot score from more than a thousand reviews. Ideal for personal projects, bots and backups if a European location works for you. [Read our Time4VPS review](/review/time4vps-review).

## 3. Hostatom: best for Thai websites

Affordable yearly hosting with servers in Bangkok, 21 days of backups and Thai-language support. [Read our Hostatom review](/review/hostatom-review).

## 4. Shinjiru: best for offshore privacy

Offshore hosting in Asia and Europe with crypto payments and privacy-friendly sign-up. User feedback on support is mixed. [Read our Shinjiru review](/review/shinjiru-review).

## 5. BitLaunch: best for paying with crypto

Deploy a VPS in minutes and pay hourly from a crypto balance, with no card required. Expect to pay a premium for that convenience. [Read our BitLaunch review](/review/bitlaunch-review).

## 6. MonoVM: best for location choice

Linux, Windows, Forex and GPU servers in 30+ locations, with crypto payments. Its Trustpilot score is low, so start with a monthly plan. [Read our MonoVM review](/review/monovm-review).

## How to choose

- **Need raw performance?** Choose dedicated or bare metal (Cherry Servers).
- **On a tight budget?** A small KVM VPS (Time4VPS) is usually enough for websites and side projects.
- **Audience in one country?** Pick a data center close to your visitors (for example Hostatom for Thailand).
- **Privacy or crypto matters?** Look at Shinjiru or BitLaunch, and accept higher prices.
- **Always test first:** start monthly, check speed and support, then commit to longer terms.

title: Best WordPress Plugins & Tools to Grow Your Site in 2026
excerpt: The plugins and services we recommend for backups, CRM automation, affiliate programs, live chat and workflow automation on WordPress.
content:
A fast theme gets visitors in the door. These tools help you keep your site safe, turn visitors into customers and automate the busywork. Every pick below is based on official documentation plus published user and expert reviews.

## Quick picks

- **Best backup & migration plugin:** [WPvivid](/review/wpvivid-review)
- **Best CRM integration:** [WP Fusion](/review/wp-fusion-review)
- **Best affiliate program plugin:** [Easy Affiliate](/review/easy-affiliate-review)
- **Best live chat for stores:** [Smartsupp](/review/smartsupp-review)
- **Best automation platform:** [Make](/review/make-review)

| Tool | What it does | Free option | Our score | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| WP Fusion | Sync WordPress with your CRM | Lite version | 4.5 / 5 | [Get WP Fusion](/go/review/review_wp_fusion) |
| Make | No-code automation | Free plan | 4.5 / 5 | [Start free](/go/review/review_make) |

## 1. WPvivid: protect your site first

Scheduled backups to the cloud, one-click migration and staging sites. The free version is generous, and Pro adds incremental backups. [Read our WPvivid review](/review/wpvivid-review).

## 2. WP Fusion: connect WordPress to your CRM

Tag users by purchases, course progress and form submissions, then trigger email automations in your CRM. Essential for membership sites and online courses. [Read our WP Fusion review](/review/wp-fusion-review).

## 3. Easy Affiliate: let partners sell for you

Launch a self-hosted affiliate program with tracking links, a partner dashboard and fraud protection, without per-affiliate fees. [Read our Easy Affiliate review](/review/easy-affiliate-review).

## 4. Smartsupp: answer questions in real time

Live chat, chatbots and visitor recordings help online stores convert more visitors. Start on the free plan. [Read our Smartsupp review](/review/smartsupp-review).

## 5. Make: automate everything else

Connect WordPress and WooCommerce to thousands of apps with a visual builder, from order notifications to content workflows. [Read our Make review](/review/make-review).

## Our recommended starter stack

- **Every site:** WPvivid for backups.
- **Selling courses or memberships:** add WP Fusion.
- **Running an online store:** add Smartsupp and Make.
- **Ready to scale with partners:** add Easy Affiliate.
